user.title: Select Charger Type
user.description: Select your charger type for automatic configuration. If your charger is not listed, select 'Other / Custom'.

charger_config.title: Charger Configuration
charger_config.description: Select your charger entities. Status values are automatically set based on the selected type.

data_description.charger_switch: Entity to start charging (switch or button, e.g., button.abb_start_charging)
data_description.charger_current: Entity to set current in amperes (e.g., number.abb_charging_current_limit)
data_description.charger_power: Current charging power sensor in watts (e.g., sensor.abb_active_power)
data_description.charger_status: Charger status sensor used to detect cable connection (e.g., sensor.abb_charging_state)
data_description.ev_soc_sensor: Vehicle battery state of charge sensor in percent - requires vehicle integration
data_description.current_unit: Unit in which the charger accepts current (most: Amperes)
data_description.status_charging_values: List of values that mean charger is charging (comma separated, e.g., '4' for ABB or 'charging,Charging' for Wallbox)
data_description.status_connected_values: List of values that mean cable is connected (comma separated, e.g., '1,2,3,4,5' for ABB)

grid_config.title: Grid Meter Configuration
grid_config.description:
Configure sensors for monitoring grid consumption and solar production.

IMPORTANT: Positive value (+) should mean import from grid, negative (-) export to grid. If reversed, check 'Invert sensor value'.

data_description.grid_sensor: Grid power sensor at main breaker (e.g., sensor.shelly_3em_total_active_power). Positive = import, negative = export.
data_description.grid_sensor_inverted: Check if your meter returns positive for export (export = +, import = -)
data_description.use_grid_template: For advanced users: combine multiple meters with Jinja2 template
data_description.grid_template: Jinja2 template to calculate grid power (e.g., {{ states('sensor.meter1')|float + states('sensor.meter2')|float }})
data_description.solar_sensor: Current solar production sensor in watts (leave empty if you don't have solar)
data_description.tariff_sensor: Current tariff block sensor (1-5). For NMPT in Slovenia use Network Tariff integration. For single tariff create dummy sensor returning '1'.

limits.title: Power Limits and Control Parameters
limits.description:
Set safety limits and tariff limits for optimal charging.

TARIFF BLOCKS:
• Slovenia (NMPT): Set different limits for blocks 1-5
• Single tariff: Set all blocks to same value
• No tariff system: Use dummy sensor with fixed value '1'

data_description.phases: Number of phases in your installation (1 or 3)
data_description.buffer: Safety power buffer to prevent breaker trip (recommended: 300-500W)
data_description.control_interval: Time in seconds between current increases. Decrease happens immediately. (recommended: 30s)
data_description.auto_mode: Which mode to activate automatically when cable is connected
data_description.reset_on_unplug: If enabled, charging mode resets to OFF when cable is disconnected
data_description.limit_block_1: NMPT Block 1 - highest tariff (e.g., 11500W for 5kW profile). For single tariff: your main power.
data_description.limit_block_2: NMPT Block 2 (e.g., 8050W). For single tariff: same as block 1.
data_description.limit_block_3: NMPT Block 3 (e.g., 5750W). For single tariff: same as block 1.
data_description.limit_block_4: NMPT Block 4 (e.g., 4600W). For single tariff: same as block 1.
data_description.limit_block_5: NMPT Block 5 - lowest tariff (e.g., 4600W). For single tariff: same as block 1.

error.grid_template_required: Template code is required when template mode is enabled

init.title: Change EVSCI Settings
init.description: Here you can change limits and sensors.

data_description.charger_power: Current charging power sensor in watts
data_description.charger_status: Charger status sensor for cable detection
data_description.ev_soc_sensor: Vehicle battery state of charge in percent
data_description.current_unit: Unit in which charger accepts current
data_description.status_charging_values: Values that mean charger is charging (comma separated)
data_description.status_connected_values: Values that mean cable is connected (comma separated)
data_description.grid_sensor: Grid power sensor. Positive = import, negative = export
data_description.grid_sensor_inverted: If your meter has reverse logic (positive = export)
data_description.use_grid_template: Use template to combine multiple meters
data_description.grid_template: Jinja2 template to calculate grid power
data_description.solar_sensor: Current solar production (leave empty if none)
data_description.limit_block_1: NMPT Block 1 or main power for single tariff
